title: host list / host public-key fail with "host access artifact or transport check failed" (running host and fresh install)
body:
Found in shakeout round 2 (38fbc3d0d9).

```
$ openagents host list
openagents host: host access: Unavailable: host access artifact or transport check failed
$ openagents host public-key
openagents host: host access: Unavailable: host access artifact or transport check failed
```
Same on this Mac (desktop app host running; `connect status` shows Online and 5 phones) and in a fresh HOME, and also while a fresh `host serve --keys DIR --control --relay …` is running in that HOME. The message gives no cause or next step. Also `host list --keychain` → `openagents host:  --keychain does not apply to this command` (double space), so there's no way to point these at the app's keychain host.

Expected: `host list`/`public-key` work against the running host (or the app's host via its control socket/keychain), and when there is no host say so plainly with the command to start one.
